final: WITH record_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, e.ID, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS patient_avg FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX, e.ID), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg) AS A FROM record_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.A, s.A - o.B AS "A − B" FROM sex_averages s JOIN overall_average o ON o.B IS NOT NULL
